! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: CORE / DISTRIBUTION MULTILAYER SWITCH
! Scenario: Profile 1: Enterprise Campus LAN
! Hostname: CAMPUS-LAN-CORE-SW01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname CAMPUS-LAN-CORE-SW01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption
ip routing

! --- VTP DOMAIN HARDENING ---
vtp mode transparent

! --- 802.1Q VLAN DATABASE DEFINITIONS ---
vlan 30
 name Student_Residential_WiFi
 exit
vlan 20
 name Academic_Labs_Workstations
 exit
vlan 10
 name Faculty_Administration
 exit
vlan 40
 name Campus_VoIP_Telephony
 exit
vlan 50
 name Facility_IoT_HVAC_Security
 exit
vlan 999
 name QUARANTINE_NATIVE_VLAN
 exit

! --- SPANNING TREE PROTOCOL (IEEE 802.1w RAPID PVST+) ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree vlan 10,20,30,40,50 priority 4096
spanning-tree portfast default
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default

! --- HARDENED 802.1Q TRUNK UPLINKS (DTP DISABLED) ---
interface range GigabitEthernet0/1 - 2
 description UPLINK-TO-ACCESS-SWITCHES
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport nonegotiate
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,40,50
 spanning-tree guard root
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- SWITCHED VIRTUAL INTERFACES (SVIs) & GATEWAYS ---
interface Vlan30
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Student_Residential_WiFi
 ip address 10.10.0.1 255.255.252.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan20
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Academic_Labs_Workstations
 ip address 10.10.4.1 255.255.254.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan10
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Faculty_Administration
 ip address 10.10.6.1 255.255.254.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan40
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Campus_VoIP_Telephony
 ip address 10.10.8.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan50
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Facility_IoT_HVAC_Security
 ip address 10.10.9.1 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- DYNAMIC ROUTING CONFIGURATION ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.10.0.1
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface Vlan30
 no passive-interface Vlan20
 no passive-interface Vlan10
 no passive-interface Vlan40
 no passive-interface Vlan50
 network 10.10.0.0 0.0.3.255 area 0
 network 10.10.4.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 10.10.6.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 10.10.8.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.10.9.0 0.0.0.63 area 0
 exit

end
write memory

! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: ACCESS LAYER SWITCH
! Scenario: Profile 1: Enterprise Campus LAN
! Hostname: CAMPUS-LAN-ACCESS-SW01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname CAMPUS-LAN-ACCESS-SW01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption

! --- VTP TRANSPARENT MODE ---
vtp mode transparent

! --- VLAN DEFINITIONS ---
vlan 30
 name Student_Residential_WiFi
 exit
vlan 20
 name Academic_Labs_Workstations
 exit
vlan 10
 name Faculty_Administration
 exit
vlan 40
 name Campus_VoIP_Telephony
 exit
vlan 50
 name Facility_IoT_HVAC_Security
 exit
vlan 999
 name QUARANTINE_NATIVE_VLAN
 exit

! --- RAPID SPANNING TREE ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst

! --- HARDENED TRUNK TO CORE SWITCH (CATALYST 2960 COMPATIBLE) ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description UPLINK-TO-CORE-DISTRIBUTION-SWITCH
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport nonegotiate
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,40,50
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- ACCESS EDGE PORTS (WITH PORTFAST & BPDU GUARD) ---
interface range FastEthernet0/1 - 24
 description ACCESS-ENDPOINTS-VLAN-30
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 30
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
 no shutdown
 exit

end
write memory

! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: ENTERPRISE BORDER / CORE ROUTER
! Scenario: Profile 1: Enterprise Campus LAN
! Hostname: CAMPUS-LAN-BORDER-ROUTER01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname CAMPUS-LAN-BORDER-ROUTER01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption

! --- INTERFACE CONFIGURATION ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description LAN-INTERNAL-CORE-LINK
 ip address 10.10.3.254 255.255.252.0
 no shutdown
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description WAN-PUBLIC-UPLINK
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- HARDENED ROUTING ENGINE PROTOCOL ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 198.51.100.1
 log-adjacency-changes
 network 10.10.0.0 0.0.3.255 area 0
 network 10.10.4.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 10.10.6.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 10.10.8.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.10.9.0 0.0.0.63 area 0
 exit

! --- ENTERPRISE DEFENSE ACCESS CONTROL LISTS (ACLs) ---
ip access-list extended ACL-ISOLATE-IOT-AND-GUEST
 remark Permit established return sessions
 permit tcp any any established
 remark Permit internal DNS and DHCP
 permit udp any any eq domain
 permit udp any any eq bootps
 permit udp any any eq bootpc
 remark Deny guest and IoT access to internal corporate subnets (RFC 1918)
 deny ip 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 172.16.0.0 0.15.255.255 172.16.199.0 0.0.0.255
 permit ip any any
 exit

end
write memory

executive_rationales: Physical Media Strategy: Deployed Cat6a 10GBASE-T for horizontal runs <=100m (IEEE 802.3an), OM4 MMF 10GBASE-SR for intra-campus backbone runs <=400m (850nm dispersion limit). All link selections strictly adhere to IEEE 802.3 attenuation and transceiver optical budgets.

Layer 2 Resiliency: Enforced IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (Rapid PVST+). Provides sub-second failure recovery (<1s) via edge port fast transitions and direct proposal-agreement handshakes, eliminating legacy 802.1D 30-50s listening/learning delays.

Subnetting & Addressing: Implemented descending bitwise VLSM allocation within 10.10.0.0/16. Allocated 5 non-overlapping subnets (2368 total addresses reserved, 1600 active hosts) achieving 67.6% address space efficiency. All wildcard masks derived via bitwise unsigned negation.

Routing Architecture: OSPF Area 0 (Single Backbone Area). Selected OSPF Area 0 because network scale (5 subnets, single Autonomous System) is well within the 50-subnet threshold for a single area. Eliminates ABR route summarization complexity while guaranteeing instant topological convergence via Dijkstra's Shortest Path First algorithm. (Reference: IETF RFC 2328 (OSPFv2)).
